mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_credential_delivery_outbox WHERE (status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at<=#{now}) OR (status='PROCESSING' AND claimed_at<=#{leaseExpiredBefore}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_credential_delivery_outbox SET status='DELIVERED',derivation_nonce=NULL,delivered_at=#{deliveredAt},last_error_code=NULL, version=version+1,edit_time=#{deliveredAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE t_credential_delivery_outbox SET status='RETRY',next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},claimed_at=NULL,last_error_code=#{errorCode}, version=version+1,edit_time=#{editTime} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE t_credential_delivery_outbox SET status='FAILED',derivation_nonce=NULL,failed_at=#{failedAt},last_error_code=#{errorCode}, version=version+1,edit_time=#{failedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='PROCESSING'
